items.prompt: Lea draws shapes in this pattern again and again. What is the 15th shape?

figure.alt: A row of shapes: star, circle, circle, triangle, star, circle, circle, triangle. The same 4 shapes keep repeating.

options.why: Star is the 13th shape, the start of the 4th group.
Triangle is the 16th shape, at the end of the 4th group.
There are no squares in this pattern.
There are no hearts in this pattern.

hints: Find the group of shapes that repeats.
Each group has 4 shapes. Count in 4s to get close to 15.
3 groups end at the 12th shape. Count on from there.
items.explanation: The group star, circle, circle, triangle repeats. 3 groups use 12 shapes, so the 13th is a star, the 14th a circle and the 15th a circle.

items.prompt: A magic bean plant has 1 leaf on day 1. Every day, the number of leaves doubles. How many leaves does it have on day 6?

head: Day
Leaves
figure.alt: A table: day 1 has 1 leaf, day 2 has 2 leaves, day 3 has 4 leaves. The number for day 6 is unknown.

options.why: 12 is 6 doubled. Double the leaves one day at a time.
16 leaves is day 5. Double once more.
Doubling 16 gives 32, not 24.
64 leaves is day 7, one day too many.

hints: Doubling means adding a number to itself.
Make a list: day 1, day 2, day 3, and so on.
Day 3 has 4 leaves. Day 4 has 4 + 4 leaves.
items.explanation: The leaves go 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 for days 1 to 6. So on day 6 there are 32 leaves.

items.prompt: Numbers are written in rows of 4. The rows turn back and forth like a snake. Which number is just below 15?

figure.alt: Numbers in rows of 4. Row 1: 1, 2, 3, 4. Row 2 goes back: 8, 7, 6, 5. Row 3: 9, 10, 11, 12. The rows keep going back and forth in the same way.

options.why: 16 is next to 15 in the same row, not below it.
17 is below 16, at the left end.
19 is below 14.
20 is below 13.

hints: Write out the next two rows.
Row 4 goes from right to left, so 13 is at the right end.
Row 4 reads 16, 15, 14, 13. Now write row 5 underneath.
items.explanation: Row 4 reads 16, 15, 14, 13, so 15 is in the 2nd column. Row 5 reads 17, 18, 19, 20, and its 2nd column is 18.

solution.say: Odd rows go left to right. Even rows go right to left.
Row 4 goes right to left, starting with 13 on the right.
15 is in column 2. Below it in column 2 is 18.

items.prompt: Ravi writes MATHS again and again: MATHSMATHSMATHS and so on. He writes 23 letters. How many letters H has he written?

options.why: There are 4 full groups, and each one has an H.
The 23rd letter is T, so the 5th group has no H yet.
There are not 6 full groups in 23 letters.
Only one letter in each group of 5 is H.

hints: Each group MATHS has 5 letters and one H.
Count in 5s to see how many full groups fit in 23 letters.
4 groups use 20 letters. Which letters come after that?
items.explanation: 23 letters are 4 full groups of MATHS (20 letters) and then M, A, T. Each full group has one H, and M, A, T has none, so there are 4 letters H.

solution.say: One group MATHS has 5 letters with 1 H.
Letters 21, 22 and 23 are M, A and T. No H there.

items.prompt: Triangles are made from sticks in a row. Each new triangle shares a side with the one before. 1 triangle uses 3 sticks. 2 triangles use 5 sticks. How many triangles can be made with 21 sticks?

head: Triangles
Sticks
figure.alt: A table: 1 triangle uses 3 sticks, 2 triangles use 5 sticks, 3 triangles use 7 sticks. How many triangles use 21 sticks is unknown.

options.why: 6 triangles use 3 + 10 = 13 sticks.
21 ÷ 3 = 7 would be right only if no sides were shared.
8 triangles use 3 + 14 = 17 sticks.
9 triangles use 3 + 16 = 19 sticks. There are 2 sticks left.

hints: The first triangle needs 3 sticks. How many does each new one need?
Each new triangle adds 2 sticks because one side is shared.
After the first triangle, 21 - 3 = 18 sticks are left.
items.explanation: The first triangle uses 3 sticks and each new triangle adds 2. The other 18 sticks make 9 more triangles, so there are 1 + 9 = 10 triangles.

solution.say: Each new triangle adds 2 sticks. Half of 18 is 9.
Check: 3 sticks plus 9 lots of 2 sticks.

figure.alt: Boxes with the numbers 3, 7, 11, an empty box, then 19 and 23.

hints: Find the jump from one number to the next.
From 3 to 7 is +4. Check 7 to 11.
Add the same jump to 11.
items.explanation: The numbers go up by 4 each time: 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23. So the missing number is 15.

items.prompt: Each number is the two numbers before it added together. What is the 8th number?

figure.alt: A pattern: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, then two empty boxes for the 7th and 8th numbers.

options.why: 11 is 8 + 3. Add the two numbers just before.
13 is the 7th number. Find one more.
Add the two numbers just before: 8 and 13.

hints: Check the rule: 1 + 1 = 2 and 1 + 2 = 3.
Keep adding the last two numbers to get the next one.
The 7th number is 5 + 8.
items.explanation: The 7th number is 5 + 8 = 13. The 8th number is 8 + 13 = 21.

solution.say: Check the rule with the numbers given.

hints: Check the rule on the first numbers.
2 doubled is 4, and 4 + 1 = 5. 5 doubled is 10, and 10 + 1 = 11.
Double 23 first.
items.explanation: Double 23 to get 46, then add 1 to get 47.

items.prompt: Nina counts in 3s. She starts at 4 and stops at 34. She says 4, 7, 10 and so on. How many numbers does she say?

figure.alt: Nina's numbers: 4, 7, 10, and so on, up to 34.

hints: Write the list, or find how far it is from 4 to 34.
From 4 to 34 is 30. Each jump is 3.
Work out how many jumps of 3 make 30.
items.explanation: From 4 to 34 is 30, which is 10 jumps of 3. 10 jumps join 11 numbers, so Nina says 11 numbers.

solution.say: 10 jumps join 11 numbers, like 10 gaps between 11 fence posts.

items.prompt: Rumah di sisi kiri Jalan Mawar bernomor genap. Nomornya 2, 4, 6, 8, dan seterusnya. Rumah ke-10 di sisi kiri bernomor berapa?

figure.alt: Nomor rumah di sisi kiri: 2, 4, 6, 8, lalu kotak kosong.

options.why: 18 adalah nomor rumah ke-9.
22 adalah nomor rumah ke-11.
24 adalah nomor rumah ke-12.

hints: Lihat hubungan urutan rumah dengan nomornya.
Rumah ke-1 bernomor 2, rumah ke-2 bernomor 4, rumah ke-3 bernomor 6.
Teruskan hitung loncat 2 sampai rumah ke-10.
items.explanation: Nomor rumah adalah 2 kali urutannya. Rumah ke-10 bernomor 2 × 10 = 20.

solution.say: Rumah ke-1 bernomor 2, ke-2 bernomor 4, ke-3 bernomor 6.

items.prompt: Bus sekolah berangkat setiap 15 menit. Bus pertama berangkat pukul 06.00. Pukul berapa bus ke-5 berangkat?

Pukul 06.45 adalah waktu bus ke-4.
Pukul 07.15 adalah waktu bus ke-6.

hints: Buat daftar jam berangkat setiap bus.
Bus ke-2 berangkat 15 menit sesudah bus pertama.

items.explanation: Bus berangkat pukul 06.00, 06.15, 06.30, 06.45, dan 07.00. Jadi bus ke-5 berangkat pukul 07.00.

solution.say: Tambahkan 15 menit untuk setiap bus berikutnya.
60 menit sama dengan 1 jam, jadi 06.45 ditambah 15 menit menjadi 07.00.

Money in the box

hints: Make a list of how much she has each day.

solution.say: She first has Rp20.000 on day 7.
